remarks: Welcome to River's Edge, a sought-after condominium community in Stamford's Springdale neighborhood! This pet-friendly complex is beautifully landscaped with vibrant blooms throughout and offers top-notch amenities including a heated pool, fitness center, club house, and scenic dog-walking paths along a peaceful creek. Unit 6D is a spacious 1,925 sq ft townhouse featuring 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and multiple living areas. The main level boasts a sun-filled living and dining room with sliding doors to a private balcony, a renovated powder room, and an updated eat-in kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Upstairs, the primary suite offers soaring ceilings, dual vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower, while the second bedroom includes custom closets and an updated full bath. The versatile 3rd-floor loft is ideal as a home office, den, or guest room. The lower level provides a laundry area, abundant storage, and direct access to the attached garage. Additional parking includes unassigned parking and ample guest spaces. Conveniently located just minutes from the Springdale train station, Merritt Parkway, Darien, shopping, dining, and all that Stamford has to offer! Get your flower boxes ready - this could be yours next!
